summary: Former Lamar County, Alabama lookout, dated to the early 1940s and removed around 2000; a water tank now stands roughly where the tower was, and the register says foundation remains lie nearby.

facts.agency: Lamar County (administers the site, per the register)
facts.status_note: Removed around 2000. A water tank stands roughly where the tower was; the register says foundation remains can be found at the end of the lot beside it.

events.note: Registered November 27, 2016 as US 1632, AL 9; nominated by Andrew Zerbe

evidence.quote: Former lookout site - courtesy of Andrew Zerbe

evidence.supports: tower was roughly where the water tank now stands
evidence.quote: Tower was roughly where water tank in picture is standing.

evidence.supports: foundations dug up to make room for the tank
evidence.quote: Remains of tower foundations were dug up to make room for the tank.

evidence.supports: foundation remains at the end of the lot next to the tank
evidence.quote: They can be found at end of lot next to tank.
State list says that this was a 100
Local forestry office says that it was actually a 120

sources.title: Vernon Lookout Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites register, Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Single source: the FFLOS register page. Build date is only 'early 1940s', so no built event is written (events need a year). Height is disputed (100 ft state list vs 120 ft local forestry office), so no height_m. Status 'gone' and 2000 removal agree with the register. The brief's second source, easternuslookouts.weebly.com/vernon.html, is not this site: the cached page lists a VERNON in Franklin County, Virginia, under Virginia notes, so the source_pages entry should be fixed. No staffing, fire, or access information in any source read; the site is administered by Lamar County and no public-access level is supported. The register's nominator also supplied the photo; no license was given, so no photo entry.
